request: 10 additional focused passes to improve usefulness and precision.
passDefinition: One distinct labeled source/path execution context per pass. These ten cases are focused regressions, not ten independent repository audits or an exhaustive coverage claim. Supplemental controls and native witnesses are outside this ledger.

admission.existingOwner: SARJ510 owns the requested explicit data-union discriminator policy; no new rule or severity change is needed.
admission.demonstratedGap: Native-valid reusable Pydantic metadata and imported types constructors warned. String field-name bindings bypassed the tag check, and unrelated local parameters hid module-level imports.
admission.harm: False warnings encourage unnecessary constructor or serialization changes; scope and metadata false negatives undermine the requested modeling policy.
admission.boundary: Nominal unions remain valid Python. This is a warning-first modeling preference with no universally safe autofix.
admission.smallestFix: Extend the existing bounded AST helper with stable runtime-value proof and scope-aware import resolution.

refinements: Accept bounded stable Discriminator and annotated FieldInfo metadata bindings without requiring extra literal fields.
Resolve exact imported pydantic.types constructors while preserving rebinding and mutation controls.
Prove string field-name arguments through unique local runtime bindings and string-only concatenation; retain the Literal-tag requirement.
Keep module-level imports independent of unrelated function parameters, with class-namespace and actual global-rebinding exclusions.
Invalidate callable metadata coverage after proven string discriminator writes through stable aliases; opaque mutation, helper escape and excessive alias graphs abstain.
Bound expansion and alias-component traversal; reuse the class field-name set rather than rebuilding it per annotation.

nativeEvidence.qualification: The global-decorator-rebinding control is runtime-only. A separate bare Final inference proposal was rejected because it failed static union narrowing; it is excluded from the ten-case improvement ledger.

upstreamReview.result: No upstream shared data-union modeling preference replaces the existing SARJ510 owner.
Callable discriminator metadata can route variants without a shared Literal field.
Literal fields remain the declared static discriminator contract; runtime string field-name configuration is a separate mechanism.

limitations: All prior inherited, generic, behavior-bearing, runtime TypeAliasType union, dynamic namespace and configuration-heavy record exclusions remain in place.
Imported field domains are not resolved across files. Unknown callable arguments, opaque mutation and helper escapes can abstain; no interprocedural effect inference is claimed.
Alias expansion, string proof, class-annotation inspection and metadata alias components use finite budgets. Large or uncertain forms can remain intentional false negatives.
The labeled cases and inspected corpora establish bounded evidence, not population-wide precision or complete recall. No automatic constructor or wire-format change is offered.

localMakeVerify.reason: Existing 120-second TypeScript artifact-build timeout on the shared VM; final-revision CI is tracked on PR 1593.

performanceNotes.runtime: CPython 3.15.0 on a shared Linux VM.
performanceNotes.isolation: Fresh interpreter per corpus and bounded batch; 250-file batch limit, verified private pins before and after.
performanceNotes.coldWarmDefinition: First and second analysis passes within each interpreter; this does not mean clearing OS caches.
performanceNotes.combinedSelection: Ten tracked Python files per corpus, taking every ceil(file_count / 10) entry from the sorted pinned inventory.
performanceNotes.baselineQualification: The baseline helper is byte-identical at 1bffab09 and the integrated baseline commit 627f79ee. Both modes use the same current canonical per-file registry.
performanceNotes.interpretation: Three paired repetitions support regression review; no speed improvement or population precision claim is made.

calibration.baseline_strategy: Same current Python engine/registry; substitute the SARJ510 data-union helper from 1bffab09.

combined.scope: All 145 canonical per-file Python rules through check_source; excludes project rules and discovery.

limitations: Shared VM load affects wall time; these measurements do not establish a speed improvement.
No observed false positives in this reviewed sample is not a population false-positive-rate estimate.
